job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description: Lead full-stack development and architecture for Spark’s broker platform. Deliver customer-facing features, partner with product/design, mentor engineers, resolve technical debt, and set engineering standards while using AI developer tools.
responsibilities: Deliver impactful full-stack features that benefit Medicare brokers and beneficiaries
Partner closely with product and design leadership to shape scope and influence roadmap decisions
Own system-level decisions within your product domain
Identify and resolve systemic sources of technical debt
Establish and evolve engineering standards while mentoring engineers
Build with modern AI-powered developer tools

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching React, Python, backend web development
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
